title: TT-Rec shared tensor train with role Mirror view
hypothesis: On MovieLens 1M explicit preference prediction, one shared TT-Rec table with role-specific Givens views will preserve utility versus independent TT-Rec tables, improve AUC by at least 0.003 over the best shared-TT non-Mirror control on each fresh seed, use at most 90% of independent-TT serialized inference bytes, and retain at least 80% of shared-TT GPU lookup throughput.
scope: A compact MovieLens 1M binary GMF screen, not a Criteo MLPerf-DLRM or large-table capacity reproduction.
physical_object: One TT-EmbeddingBag core set for a concatenated 9,992-row user/item namespace; the common GMF head is shared.
mirror_coordinate: Sixteen trainable Givens angles per role applied after the TT embedding lookup.
logical_multiplicity: Two role-specific embedding functions from one physical TT core set.

dataset.name: GroupLens MovieLens 1M
dataset.citation: F. Maxwell Harper and Joseph A. Konstan. 2015. The MovieLens Datasets: History and Context. ACM TiiS 5(4), Article 19. DOI 10.1145/2827872.
dataset.access_terms: Research use only; cite Harper and Konstan (2015); no redistribution; no commercial/revenue-bearing use without GroupLens permission.
dataset.task_label: rating >=4 is positive; ratings 1-3 are negative
dataset.prior_audit_exclusion: Exclude pairs whose MA-1063 SHA256(user_id:item_id) modulo 10 is 9 or whose MA-1064 SHA256(MA-1064:user_id:item_id) modulo 10 is 9 among non-MA-1063 rows.
dataset.split: Among eligible pairs, SHA256(MA-1066:user_id:item_id) modulo 10: 0-7 train, 8 dev, 9 fresh audit. Pair IDs and labels are not persisted.

model.optimizer: Adam lr=0.001, weight_decay=1e-6, batch=4096, FP32, one GPU stream; no cache for all methods.
model.lookup: One index per bag using identical TT-EmbeddingBag backend/version and cache=false for every TT method.

controls: Independent user and item native TT-Rec tables (strong compressed control)
One shared TT-Rec table with no role view
One shared TT-Rec table plus matched 16-value-per-role paired diagonal gains
One shared TT-Rec table plus FiLM per role (simple parameterization control)
One shared TT-Rec table plus 16-angle-per-role Givens Mirror
Independent full-cardinality user/item dense embedding tables (upper control)

development.selection: For each method, select epoch 1-3 by mean dev logloss over both seeds; all tuning is dev-only.

fresh.training_data: Frozen eligible train split; fresh initialization per seed.
fresh.audit_data: Frozen 10% split among previously unscored pairs.

success_gate: On both fresh seeds, shared-TT+Givens AUC >= best shared-TT non-Mirror control +0.003; logloss <= independent TT +0.002; complete serialized inference payload <=90% of independent TT; and same-GPU, same-cache throughput >=80% of shared TT no-view. Also require AUC within 0.02 of full-table upper control.
failure_gate: Miss any fresh quality, storage, utility-floor, or throughput gate; or a matched diagonal/FiLM view is within 0.003 AUC on both seeds.
boundaries: The reference FBTT-Embedding code is pinned; no upstream changes are allowed inside its vendored directory.
The audit is not run until source is reviewed, a GPU is identified, and this protocol/runner hashes are frozen.
This deterministic MovieLens split and two seeds are not independent data worlds or a capacity claim.
No parameters or bytes are inferred from tensor counts alone; serialized payload plus all metadata/cache state is authoritative.
Do not redistribute MovieLens data or use it commercially without permission.
